title: Ellen 電動渡輪
summary: 以Ellen電動渡輪作島嶼運輸案例，把較長充電間隔、載荷與服務時窗列進任務帳，練習如何提出缺少量測時仍可審查的比較。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Ellen for island transport, including longer charging intervals, payload and service windows in a mission ledger and making comparisons reviewable even when measurements are missing. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 定義服務量是人次還是貨重距離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Define service as passengers or payload-distance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 定義服務量是人次還是貨重距離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Define service as passengers or payload-distance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 定義服務量是人次還是貨重距離：噸公里是載重乘距離，可比較同一服務量的能源需求；空載回程會改變整個任務帳。 本步以「載運功能單位與效率」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Define service as passengers or payload-distance: Tonne-kilometres are payload times distance and compare energy for equal service; empty return legs change the mission ledger. Use Transport functional units and efficiency to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Ellen 電動渡輪實際規格：貨物m=1100 t、距離d=500 km。式 Wtransport=md，基準結果 550000 t·km。條件：單程貨重距離指標，不是機械做功，也未含空載和港口能耗。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Ellen electric ferry: Cargo m=1100 t, distance d=500 km. Formula Wtransport=md gives 550000 t·km. Conditions: One-way payload-distance indicator, not mechanical work; empty legs and port energy excluded.
steps.failure: 只用最大載重而非實際載重會美化每噸公里指標；需核對裝載率。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Using maximum rather than actual payload artificially improves per-tonne-kilometre metrics; inspect utilization. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 分別填裝載與空載航段的燃料和距離，使用同一邊界比較不同船型。 本案例另須檢查「定義服務量是人次還是貨重距離」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Log fuel and distance for loaded and empty legs separately and compare vessels under a common boundary. Also check that Define service as passengers or payload-distance and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：定義服務量是人次還是貨重距離。在島嶼渡輪時間線、能量餘量圖與乘載卡完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加貨物質量10%，保持距離，算服務量；不得假設能耗必不變。 算式區的基準值為550000，改變後為605000 t·km。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Define service as passengers or payload-distance. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Island-ferry timeline, energy-margin plot and load cards. Increase payload alone by 10%, retain distance and calculate service without assuming unchanged energy. Baseline 550000 changes to 605000 t·km. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Ellen 電動渡輪」的「定義服務量是人次還是貨重距離：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海上能源：岸電交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Define service as passengers or payload-distance: Mechanism and observation” in “Ellen electric ferry”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.instructionEn: Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Ellen 電動渡輪實際規格：新增質量m=110 t、ρ=1.025 t/m³、水線面積A=2000 m²。式 ΔT=Δm/(ρAw)，基準結果 0.053658537 m。條件：小變化、定水線面積與密度；不是港口吃水或裝載安全判定。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Ellen electric ferry: Added mass m=110 t, ρ=1.025 t/m³, waterplane area A=2000 m². Formula ΔT=Δm/(ρAw) gives 0.053658537 m. Conditions: Small change at fixed waterplane area and density; not a port-draft or loading-safety determination.

steps.failureEn: Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 把平均吃水、艏吃水和艉吃水分欄，先核對港水密度，再比較新增重量。 本案例另須檢查「比較載荷對平均吃水的概念影響」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：比較載荷對平均吃水的概念影響。在島嶼渡輪時間線、能量餘量圖與乘載卡完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加新增貨物質量10%，比較平均吃水增量，明示未計縱傾。 算式區的基準值為0.053658537，改變後為0.05902439 m。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Compare payload effects on mean draft. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Island-ferry timeline, energy-margin plot and load cards. Increase added cargo mass alone by 10%, compare mean-draft increment and explicitly exclude trim. Baseline 0.053658537 changes to 0.05902439 m. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
